source: Taibi et al. 2024 A&A 689 A88, DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/202449468, published PDF, section 6.2 p17
independence: Two stellar populations (RGS and main sequence), equated circular velocity via asymmetric-drift corrections; independent of the HI inclination, conditional on shared potential and inclination and dynamical profile assumptions. General method uses a core radius estimated from HI, so not wholly HI-free.
limitations: General model assumes axisymmetry, spherical potential and rotation flattening; uniform cos(i) prior, velocity ellipsoid parameter and HI-derived core radius randomized. Thin disk photometric angle presumes intrinsic shape. Inclination uncertainty is large; published uncertainties do not validate a Gaussian angle posterior for the purpose of a law likelihood.
